"INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2"

offending_extra_words: and all amounts due under this Agreement
reasons: The redline completes every atomic element of the preferred position: a mutual greater-of cap (12 months' fees paid or payable preceding the claim / USD 1,000,000), the retained mutual indirect-damages waiver, and uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, data protection, security, IP, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud, plus the payment-obligations carve-out.
Fallback is not separately satisfied because the cap is a greater-of formulation rather than a flat 12 months' fees cap; this is immaterial since the locked target level is preferred and is met.

Minimality is missed only by the additional phrase "and all amounts due under this Agreement", which broadens the payment-obligations carve-out beyond the playbook's "Customer's payment obligations" and is unnecessary to complete the preferred level.

Intent is preserved: the original waiver sentence and all existing carve-out cross-references remain effective, "Excluded Claims" is defined where used, and no dangling mechanic or contradiction is introduced.
